title: A record a named proof reads is measured, not skipped
intention: The hollow skips a record (history.json, state.json, validations/) as SKIP_RECORD only when no proof in the ticket's instrument names that record's repo-relative path in its source; a record a named proof reads is reverted and that proof's declared teeth are watched like any source file.
why: A record repair (ticket ba8c62b8203e) cannot be hollow-measured today: SKIP_RECORD skips every history.json on the premise that no proof asserts over it, so a boat whose whole build is a record its own proof reads refuses at the hollow rung with hollow_nothing_measured. The skip should apply where its premise holds and nowhere else.
traces_to: Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass — today a record repair cannot be hollow-measured at all, so ba8c62b8203e would refuse hollow_nothing_measured); Law 7 (SKIP_RECORD's stated premise 'no proof asserts over it' is a diagnostic claim that is false for records a proof reads).
how: In cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py: one helper reads the instrument_set() files' source text once; _classify gains a keyword `read_by` (that text) and returns SKIP_RECORD only when `rel` does not appear in it. The three call sites (:265 build-commit filter, :917 and :924 per-file classify) pass it for the repo side and an empty string for the commons side, exactly as they pass `instrument`. Red-first tooth in cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py: a fixture whose instrument proof names comp/history.json and asserts what the build wrote there; the run must measure comp/history.json with that tooth red and not skip it. test_a_record_named_in_writes_to_is_skipped_and_a_plain_json_beside_it_is_not (fixture proof names no record) and test_every_writes_to_file_being_a_record_is_still_a_red_not_a_free_green stay green unchanged.
falsifier: Done when cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py's new tooth test_a_record_a_named_proof_reads_is_reverted_and_its_tooth_watched is green under bin/cairn test (red at HEAD 34699427: comp/history.json comes back in skipped as SKIP_RECORD), while test_a_record_named_in_writes_to_is_skipped_and_a_plain_json_beside_it_is_not and test_every_writes_to_file_being_a_record_is_still_a_red_not_a_free_green stay green with their source unchanged, and the whole file is green. Horizon: this voyage. Wrong intent if a record the instrument names is reverted and the proof's tooth does not red although the proof asserts over it — then the substring test found a mention, not a read.
watchme: none, because the first live use is ba8c62b8203e's hollow run, which reverts two history.json files its proof cairn/tools/charter/proofs/test_the_two_bypass_rows_carry_their_predecessors_standing.py reads; a wrong skip refuses that boat with hollow_nothing_measured
children: none, because one predicate in one function (cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py _classify), its three callers, and one tooth in cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py
questions: none, because peer akiendelllinux_cc_0 ruled the design (F7 (b)) as the skip matching its own premise, with no sealed claim moving; the parent need is ticket ba8c62b8203e
gates_bound: Proved: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py green and sealed under bin/cairn test with the new tooth declared under PROVES for this ticket; a hollow reading over hollow.py that reverts it and watches the tooth red; feeds back to origin on failure (a red returns the boat to FIXME).
